summary: Enhance your NGO's financial skills with our comprehensive training course. Learn effective management strategies to ensure sustainability and growth.
lede: NGO financial management connects grant budgets, accounting records, internal controls, cash forecasts and donor reporting. For finance and programme professionals who prepare, review or use NGO financial information, the course develops practical skills in classifying restricted funds, analysing budget variances, preparing rolling cash forecasts and documenting donor requirements with clear audit trails.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who prepare, review, approve, audit, or use NGO financial information. It suits foundation to intermediate learners who need a structured finance workflow and practical reporting artefacts.
audience: Country or Programme Directors using financial dashboards
prerequisites: No formal accounting qualification or programming background is required. You should have basic familiarity with organizational budgets, invoices, expenses, or grant-funded activities. Basic Microsoft Excel skills will help you complete the analysis exercises, and you should bring anonymised examples of finance challenges if your organization permits.
